item.title: MacRumors: watchOS 27.3 Brings Live Rewind and Siri Recap to Apple Watch

item.title: 9to5Mac Apple Watch: watchOS 27.3 beta adds new Siri Recap and Live Rewind features for Apple Watch
item.description: Apple has released the first beta of watchOS 27.3 for developers, including two new Audio Intelligence features for Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4: Siri Recap and Live Rewind.
